verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events stores collected events in the customer's own warehouse, so the event history remains available (hightouch-docs-5, hightouch-comm-3). Models built on that warehouse data can be synced to any of 300+ destinations, which implies history can be pushed to a newly added tool (hightouch-docs-23, hightouch-docs-27, hightouch-docs-49). However, the docs describe CDC syncs that send only new, changed, and removed rows, and say nothing about a replay, backfill, or full-resync operation. Missing for 10: a documented event replay or backfill feature, a full-resync or reset-CDC option for recovering a broken pipeline, explicit confirmation that a new sync's first run sends all historical rows, and hands-on corroboration.
